'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Attacks on schools during the Israeli invasion of Gaza]]
****An [[Israel]]i strike on a school sheltering [[displaced people]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] kills 28 people and injures 54 others. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-10-10-2024-a5e53cdd4fca30be1909506b5c777922 (AP)]
**[[List of military aid to Israel during the Israel–Hamas war|Military aid to Israel during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Chancellor of Germany]] [[Olaf Scholz]] announces plans for [[Germany]] to supply [[Israel]] with a new shipment of weapons, and that the [[Cabinet of Germany|German government]] has agreed to continue shipments for at least the near future. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/10/10/germany-will-supply-more-weapons-to-israel-chancellor-scholz-announces (Euronews)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***An [[Israel]]i [[Merkava]] tank opens fire on a [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL]] checkpoint in [[southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]], injuring two [[peacekeeping|peacekeepers]]. Israeli troops also open fire on two other UN positions near the [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|Blue Line]], although no casualties are reported. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crm211mnev0o (BBC News)]
**At least 22 people are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on two different areas in central [[Beirut]], Lebanon. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-10-10-2024-a5e53cdd4fca30be1909506b5c777922 (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[October 2024 Sudan airstrikes]]
***[[Sudan]]ese [[human rights group]] Emergency Lawyers reports that over 500 Sudanese civilians have been killed in airstrikes conducted by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] on multiple civilian areas held by the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/activists-report-spike-mass-civilian-deaths-after-sudans-army-ups-airstrikes-2024-10-10/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/over-500-sudanese-killed-in-air-strikes (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[World Bank]] approves a new financial intermediary fund consisting of grants from the [[United States]], [[Japan]], [[Canada]], and other countries coupled with interest from frozen [[Russia|Russian]] assets to give to [[Ukraine]] as part of a [[USD|$]]50 billion loan. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/world-bank-board-approves-new-ukraine-fund-with-money-us-japan-canada-sources-2024-10-10/ (Reuters)]
**Ukraine's [[Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War]] confirms the death of journalist [[Victoria Roshchyna]], who had been held prisoner by Russia since August 2023. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-confirms-death-of-viktoria-roshchyna-ukrainian-journalist-held-in-russian-captivity/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**At least twenty-one miners are killed and six others are injured in an attack by unknown armed militants on a private [[coal mine]] in [[Duki District]], [[Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-20-killed-attack-miners-southwestern-pakistan-police-say-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2024 Nobel Prize in Literature]]
**This year's [[Nobel Prize]] in Literature is awarded to South Korean writer [[Han Kang]] "for her intense poetic prose that confronts historical traumas and exposes the fragility of human life". [https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/literature/2024/press-release/ (Nobel Prize)]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*One person is killed and twelve others are trapped when an elevator fails at the [[Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine]] in [[Cripple Creek, Colorado|Cripple Creek]], [[Colorado]], [[United States]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/one-killed-and-12-trapped-underground-at-mine-tourist-attraction-in-colorado-13231713 (Sky News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**At least ten people are killed in damages by [[tornado]]es caused by [[Hurricane Milton]] in [[Florida]], United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/hurricane-milton-weakens-it-marches-across-central-florida-homes-destroyed-2024-10-10/ (Reuters)]
*In its annual [[Living Planet Index|Living Planet report]], the [[World Wildlife Fund]] estimates that [[wildlife|wild]] populations of animal species have [[decline in wild mammal populations|decreased]] over 70% since 1970, with some [[High-Biodiversity Wilderness Area|high-biodiversity]] areas seeing up to 95% declines. [https://www.dw.com/en/wwf-wildlife-populations-have-plummeted-by-73-since-1970/a-70453189 (DW)]

**[[Italy|Italian]] [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giorgia Meloni]] summons the [[Israel]]i ambassador to Italy after Israeli forces target bases manned by Italian peacekeepers in [[Southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Malaysia]], [[Murder of Shaariibuugiin Altantuyaa]]
**The [[Federal Court of Malaysia]] [[commutation (law)|commutes]] the death sentence of Azilah Hadri, one of Altantuyaa's murderers, to 40 years imprisonment. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/altantuya-murder-malaysia-azilah-sirul-death-sentence-jail-najib-razak-4670521 (CNA)]
*Multiple [[Palestinians|Palestinian]], [[Dutch people|Dutch]], and [[Jews|Jewish]] [[Human rights organisations|human rights organizations]] sue the [[Politics of the Netherlands|Dutch government]] for exporting weapons and military goods to [[Israel]], thereby allegedly failing to prevent violations of the [[Genocide Convention]] and other [[War crimes in the Israel–Hamas war|war crimes]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/dutch-state-sued-over-alleged-failure-stop-israels-violations-international-law-2024-10-10/ (Reuters)]

**[[United Nations]] [[human rights]] investigators accuse Israel of [[crimes against humanity]] and the crime of [[extermination (crime)|extermination]] by deliberately targeting [[health facilities]] and [[medic|medical personnel]] in Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/10/un-inquiry-accuses-israel-of-deliberately-hitting-gaza-health-facilities (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Tomb of Christopher Columbus]]
**Researchers from the [[University of Granada]] confirm that bones lying in the [[Seville Cathedral]] in [[Seville]], [[Andalusia]], [[Spain]], belonged to [[Christopher Columbus]]. [https://www.abc.es/cultura/ultimo-secreto-adn-colon-20241010113859-nt.html (ABC Spain)]
*The [[Internet Archive]] and the [[Wayback Machine]] are taken offline following a [[denial-of-service attack]], with the hackers also stealing 31 million [[password hashes]] in a [[data breach]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/daveywinder/2024/10/10/internet-hacked-wayback-machine-down-31-million-passwords-stolen/ (''Forbes'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Erling Haaland]] becomes the all-time top goalscorer of the [[Norway national football team]] with 34 goals in the last 36 matches, beating [[Jørgen Juve]]'s 1934 record of 33 goals. [https://www.espn.com/football/story/_/id/41721566/erling-haaland-norway-leading-scorer (ESPN)]
